link.basis: Previously reviewed and independently evaluated component; unchanged.

resolution.basis: Previously reviewed and independently evaluated component; unchanged.

rejectedOrUnproven.verification: No candidate passed all validation categories; baseline audit has 14/16 correct outcomes, with two uncertain outcomes on the same valid deduplication.
rejectedOrUnproven.removable: Selected candidate improved test but source-cluster interval includes zero; retain baseline.
rejectedOrUnproven.relation: Initial candidate contradicted the existing-link case; fresh candidates regressed on topic-only negatives. One 503 was preserved and did not stop work.
rejectedOrUnproven.destination_initial: Initial candidate incorrectly excluded event pages; superseded by separately evaluated compatible candidate from fresh sources.
rejectedOrUnproven.duplicate_initial: Page-subject restriction held for fresh evaluation; superseded by claim-level identity candidate.
rejectedOrUnproven.residue_initial: Citation/follow-up conflation rejected; superseded by candidate preserving useful citations and human testimony.

semanticRationale.actionable: Keeps useful introductions/summaries, original sources and distinct details; clarifies paraphrase and repeated-core consolidation without weakening preservation.
semanticRationale.destination: Judges page suitability relative to the shared information, includes canonical event pages, distinguishes equal suitability from neither supported. Fixed criteria and deterministic tie breaking remain unchanged.
semanticRationale.duplicate: Compares the factual claim and its referent, explicitly permits shared claims across pages with different primary subjects, preserves distinct homonyms.
semanticRationale.residue: Separates agent maintenance and invented human tasks from subject facts, useful citations and original human testimony; detection does not authorize deleting mixed content.

activation: Registered locally only. JEV_PROMPT_PROFILE remains baseline.
compositionLimit: Each component has its own independent offline evaluation. No claim of measured end-to-end improvement from combining all components; editor and production pages were not exercised.
